source: Owner's goal and «Да, план» in the project chat, then seven product questions answered in the planning session (two rounds)
ownerInstruction: сделать удобным и увлекательным проект настолько, чтобы была масса впечатлений и хотелось всегда возвращаться ради новых кампаний и приключений в кругу семьи и друзей. Теплый и ламповый портал в увлекательные D&D миры

answers.starsAndWishesReaders: Звёзды всем, пожелания мастеру (Recommended): everyone at the table reads the stars; a wish is read by its author and the DM only
answers.nextGameReminder: Дата + файл календаря (Recommended): the date in the hub and the campaign, a calendar file, the person's own calendar reminds; no notification from LTW, no push service
answers.partyAlbum: Галерея из картинок игры (Recommended): places visited, faces met and handouts shown to the party, as the party knows them; no uploaded photographs
answers.neighboursInThePackage: Договор стола (игра с детьми), Памятка новому мастеру, Дом между мирами, Мелкие удобства: all four chosen
answers.nativeApps: Да, отдельным малым этапом (Recommended): the shells learn to hand a calendar file to the system and to print or save a PDF; a new build and install on the family's devices; until then the buttons work in a browser
answers.beforeThePlaytest: Ритуал вечера до, остальное после (Recommended): «Ранее…», stars and wishes, the next date, the table's agreement and the DM's guide before the family playtest; the book with its gallery, the home between worlds and small comforts after it
answers.offHostBackups: Отдельной задачей, вне пакета (Recommended): a separate task on the owner's separate word and choice of place; the server is not touched by this package

authorization: Stage 710 on 2026-11-15: «Да, этап 710», answered to the question «Начинать этап 710 («Ранее…» и глава вечера)?» after the plan was shown, typed by the owner in the planning session; the session that started it relayed the same word given there («Да, начать 710»). It covers Stage 710 alone, in its own pull request; no merge, no deployment
delegation: None recorded. The session's defaults are marked (S) in the plan's decisions and stay the owner's to overrule; every stage starts on the owner's word.
askedAtTheTime: Starting each stage, merges into main, deployments, native builds on the family's devices, the place for off-host backup copies.
unchangedBoundaries: World Engine authority: stars, wishes, the next date, the agreement and keepsakes are table data beside the world, never canonical
knowledge isolation: everything shown to players, cast, exported or printed is the PARTY perspective's; a wish is its author's and the DM's
AI optional: every stage works without a key; no new paid call
no push service, no service worker, no third-party SDK (FULL_GAME_PLAN decision 10, ADR 0070)
all art from the OpenAI image model; the app draws only game markup
human play acceptance is the owner's and is reported honestly
